name: ace-proagents
description: ACE — the agent skill + CLI that builds workspaces for autonomous coding agents. One command installs a governed crew into any repository: terminal spaces, browser spaces, a governor over a global worker budget, one supervisor and its workers per project, durable memory, and the task contract every mission ends with. Works on Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, Copilot and any AGENTS.md harness.

scripts.check: node --check ace.mjs && for f in lib/*.mjs lib/adapters/*.mjs assets/stack/orchestration/*.mjs assets/stack/orchestration/lib/*.mjs site/app.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done

ace.name: ace
ace.description: ACE — install a crew of coding agents into a repository, then govern it: Herdr spaces, one browser space per project, a governor over a global worker budget, supervisors and workers that name the outcome of every task, ACC memory and the Charter task contract.

goal.statement: Ship an orchestrator-first Agentic Compute Environment whose governor keeps per-project supervisors and workers moving toward each goal inside a central agent budget, with isolated workspaces, durable state, bounded failover and an independent watchdog — reporting only what it can evidence.
